_howTo: Cigars page 'Pair it with a pour'. Each pairing has a cigar profile, a short note, and 1-2 bottles to suggest. bottle.photo is a file name in src/assets/photos/ (leave "" for no photo). Edit freely to match what you carry.

pairings.note: Smooth, nutty and easy-going. Go with a softer, sweeter wheated bourbon that won't run it over.
Pepper, cedar and a little sweetness. A high-rye bourbon matches the spice note for note.
Dark chocolate, espresso and earth. It takes a big, high-proof pour to stand up to it.
